item.title: The Day I Decided to Own It - Real Leaders
item.description: A departing executive’s blunt feedback forced a driven leader to confront how her intensity and unpredictability were affecting her team. Choosing to become more steady and accountable, she proved her growth during a major ransomware crisis by leading with calm and clarity. The experience reinforced that receiving feedback with humility — and owning what’s yours — is the key to becoming a stronger, more trusted leader.
